WI-WIT-07.scope: Pinned memory32/UTF-8 lowering, lifting, copied buffers, allocation failure, malformed input and cleanup without partial trusted results.
WI-WIT-07.boundary: Independent typed peer round trips and separate hostile-import probes over unchanged emitted core Wasm are distinguished; engine-wide allocation counts and zero-copy are not claimed.

BE-RESOURCE-01.scope: Actual Wasmtime DRC collection does not discharge a live native pin or resource obligation.

BE-BOUNDARY-01.scope: Pinned ABI conversion accounts for copies, allocation and cleanup on normal and failed paths.
BE-BOUNDARY-01.boundary: Core diagnostic counters are not all physical engine allocations or copies.

RA-OWN-02.scope: Move-only, noncapturable owners; reachability is separate from retirement and physical release.

VT-SCOPE-02.scope: Production resource-table and authority decisions remain safe sequential no_std Rust and participate in actual whole-crate extraction and compiled declaration accounting.
VT-SCOPE-02.boundary: Seven named resource roots claim strict correspondence/invariants; whole-source accounting is not universal authority, frontend or backend refinement.

VT-SCOPE-03.scope: The host supplies explicit current facts, executes only committed typed work, authenticates scoped observations and applies returned resource accounting separately from pure retirement decisions.
VT-SCOPE-03.boundary: Serialization, namespace freshness, authenticated callbacks/facts and faithful physical application remain explicit embedding correspondence obligations.

H-AUTH-01.scope: Every admitted bootstrap import and cleanup operation has an explicit protected or scoped unprotected classification; protected plans, authorization, attempts, observations and receipts remain distinct.

H-AUTH-02.scope: Only the trusted host establishes witnesses after checking exact operation, plan/arguments, actor/owner, policy, checkpoint, validity and quota bindings; missing required current facts fail closed.
H-AUTH-02.boundary: One serialized local synchronization scope; no remote authorization atomicity or credential-authenticity theorem.

H-AUTH-03.scope: Admission consumes the one-shot witness and records the attempt before execution; failed preflight preserves valid obligations, while committed failure/cancellation/unknown cannot restore or retry authorization.

H-AUTH-04.scope: Opaque Rust and guest resource boundaries prevent unchecked witness construction, generic duplication/discard/serialization and Data/Capture eligibility.

H-RECEIPT-01.scope: Receipt admission requires applicable authenticated observations for the exact attempt, operation, source, context and requested outcome; absent, failed, unknown or unrelated observations do not establish success.

H-RECEIPT-02.scope: Operation receipts remain separate from invocation outcome; confirmed late operation success cannot uncancel invocation delivery, restore ownership or recreate witness authority.

assumptions: Rust, the supplied native executables, the pinned wasm-tools, Bash/prlimit quota-probe tools, Node/V8, Wasmtime, the filesystem and this gate are trusted execution tooling.
Copied source bytes and executable hashes bind the observations; separate build provenance is required to establish that the supplied native binaries were built from these sources.
The Rust peer independently implements canonical component linking and typed conversion, but deliberately reuses the production Noble resource/authority decision libraries for host policy.
Native resource tests concern deterministic ownership and pin accounting. Physical native releases, real credentials and authenticated external observations remain trusted host obligations.
Core hostile-import probes execute unchanged production Wasm. Their diagnostics are core-only instrumentation, never exported WIT or an independent Component Model implementation.
Success-path canonical post-return and explicit trap-path host cleanup are distinct. Core counters do not measure all engine allocations or physical copies.
The seven strict resource roots admit only propext, Classical.choice and Quot.sound; compiled whole-source declaration accounting is not proof of every authored body.
Pinned Rust/Charon/Aeneas/Lean, explicit standard-library models and inherited reviewed opaque helpers remain tooling/model boundaries.
Trusted host serialization, namespace freshness, current facts, authenticated callbacks, faithful physical release and engine/ABI behavior are explicit embedding obligations.
The resource correspondence theorem does not establish universal authority-system, receipt-adapter, component frontend/backend, WASI or native-async correctness.
